evidence: grid_editing.go:161-173 is the only non-nil assignment to gridBinding.editing. It constructs a private ui.TextField node, checks mountControl error, assigns returned widget, then publishes the complete binding/record. No public descriptor or extension can inject this private record.

controls.go:115-119 handles the fixed ui.TextField kind using core.NewTextField(parent), so successful private mount always stores concrete non-nil *core.TextField. The same constructor already asserts this concrete type at grid_editing.go:175.
gridEditingRecord at grid_editing.go:47-53 returns only published, visible, nonretired private records. It has no public setters and never returns generic children or pooled cell widgets.

disposeEditing at grid_editing.go:133-141 clears g.editing before disposeControl/widget.Delete; disposed controls cannot be returned through gridEditingRecord. disposeGrid marks the grid closed before disposing its editor (grid.go:668-676).

capture at grid_geometry.go:74-76 refuses retired lifetime; its field read at122-125 follows this retained-type invariant. Capture/layout and native record refresh/retirement follow the existing originating render ownership; domain callback source mutation only invalidates, never rewrites private widget/binding pointers.
limits: This adjudication concerns the hypothetical nil/wrong-type internal state, not arbitrary corruption or unsupported reflection mutation of private driver records.
No production change, test relaxation or new broader thread-safety claim. Actual Cocoa acceptance remains separately recorded.
